item.title: Gl52 5jf, 21st July
item.description:
Lime trees by Prestbury WI hall need cutting. Encroaching over our hedge and blocking the road sign by the roundabout and also the power lines. Emailed in April to see if we could cut some branches but told we couldn’t as might have nesting birds . Totally understandable. We would appreciate it if this could be resolved asap. Thank you !

item.title: Tree is damaged problem, 21st July
item.description:
Email received 13/07/2026 - copy attached. Customer reports an Issue with school maintenance and hedges and trees over grown damaging property and not being cared for. Unfortunately, they have tried approaching the school with no joy. They would like the trees to be cut and the bushes taken under control; it used to be done regularly and it’s not been done for 4 yrs and is now affecting their property. It isn’t safe for their children.

item.title: Both 30 mph signs not at all visible., 21st July
item.description:
This has been an ongoing issue for months. Local council have been involved with highways. And absolutely nothing has been done. This is far beyond a danger as cars drive up through the 30mph at 60 mph as the signs are so badly hidden in the hedges you can tell what speed it is as there is no street lights people assume it is still 60mph as the 30mph signs are invisible. Danger and dangerous. Needs fixing straight away.
